segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin who rarely uses makeup reported her face looked smoother and brighter within hours; another with combination/oily skin found it non-greasy and matte-finishing.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as reliably hydrating, with one reporting that longstanding dry patches on her face cleared up after two weeks and another recommending it specifically for dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one in a hot humid climate, found it hydrating without feeling heavy, though one suggested adding a richer cream if skin runs very dry.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describe their skin as sensitive or reactive and report no irritation or breakouts, including one with allergies who normally reacts to skincare and one using it during a stressful period without any reaction.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s report firmer, more toned, hydrated skin and reduced fine lines with regular use, some using it for years or decades.

concerns.aging: Multiple mature reviewers report firmer, more even-toned skin and softened fine lines over weeks to years of use; a few, however, note no visible change to fine lines even after weeks of daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Widely reported as hydrating and plumping, easing dry patches and tightness for dry and dehydrated skin; one reviewer felt it was not hydrating enough on its own and paired it with a heavier moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with reactive skin reports less redness within the first week; another with normal use reports no new redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes it calming her skin barrier quickly after aggressive exfoliation; another notes it strengthens the skin barrier with regular use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports a lightening effect on spots alongside hydration; hyperpigmentation improvement is also reported by a reviewer combining it with a retinol.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no new breakouts even on skin prone to reacting; one reviewer reports it cleared some existing blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report it leaves a matte, non-greasy finish and does not add shine or an oily look.

extraits.texte: I am using it twice a day as instructed, but have not seen any visible result. And it caused my skin around eyes swell.

extraits.titre: Love Shiseido products, this one included!
extraits.texte: As many others have mentioned, Shiseido does use fragrance in their skin care. I usually lean towards fragrance free, but I've had such great experiences with other Shiseido products that I am willing to overlook the fragrance aspect. My main skin concerns were hyperpigmentation and dryness, and this product has worked well for both of those concerns. I pair it with a retinol for an extra boost.

*Received free in exchange for honest review I've used this serum for a month and am pretty impressed. It's lightweight, sinks in quickly, plays well with other products and despite the faint fragrance, never caused any irritation to my ultra sensitive and reactive skin. I noticed less redness within the first week and over time, my skin is softer and more even in tone. I don't see much difference in fine lines this soon but I have high hopes as I keep using. I definitely recommend.

I delayed reviewing this product, as I like to give skincare a decent amount of time to do it's thing before I decide if I really like it or not. Boy, am I glad I did because this product took a minute to show it's stuff. I'm a skincare snob of sorts, so it's difficult to impress me. I've tried high end and low end and everything in between. Despite all my products, age has gotten the best of me and my complexion has gone from combination skin, leaning toward a bit oily, to very dry, with these weird dry patches around the perimeter of my face (forehead, outer cheeks, chin) that are very difficult to keep moisturized. Well let me tell you, this serum has done the trick. I actually can't believe it! After 1 week, I noticed some change, but the patches were still there when I would wake up in the morning. But after 2 weeks, I was floored. The patches of weird, dry skin were gone! Completely moisturized! Wow! I have tried many serums, and although some of them have accomplished an improvement in my new found skin problems, none of them have completely cleared them up like this product! Very impressed and will definitely continue using!

This is the first product I've ever tried from Shisedo, and I was pleasantly surprised. There is a light, clean, pleasant scent and a lightweight texture. I have combination skin and live in a hot, humid climate, which means I need a hydrating product - this hydrated without overdoing it. I think this would work for most skin types, but if you have really dry skin you'd probably need to make sure to add a heavier cream moisturizer on top. Overall, I definitely recommend this to most people looking for a hydration step in their skincare routine that also adds some nice anti-aging effects.

This is probably a TMI review but I used this serum morning and night after my mother passed and while I couldn't do much, this serum helped me feel like I was doing something. My face felt really plump and healthy and I have super sensitive skin that normally reacts to everything but it didn't react to this. I was gifted this product for my review but I would and absolutely will be buying this when I run out.

I really liked this serum. It was non greasy, and did seem to lighten spots and hydrate. I didn't notice much help on the fine lines, but I think with daily use it may help. It didn't break me out like other serums can and it worked nicely with my moisturizer. It didn't burn my skin either, so it wasn't too strong
